summary: Liner's developer site offers new users up to $15 in free API credits ('No purchase necessary. Just add your card.'). Credits are a prepaid balance that pays for any Liner API: the Liner Model API ($1 input / $5 output per 1M tokens on liner-mark-1.3), Web Search ($1 per 1,000 requests), Scholar Search ($0.3 per 1,000), and the Agent APIs (Quick Answer $3, Search Agent $20, Deep Research $200 per 1,000 requests).
claim_steps: Open https://liner.com/developers and select Claim now / Get started
Sign up and add a card (no purchase necessary)
Create an API key under API Keys in the dashboard; check the credit balance with GET /api/v1/credits/balance (free)
